title: Step 68-G Step-Up protected sales-control preview and apply administration
description: Implement the HIGH-risk AD-C-08 Admin Sales-Control workspace on canonical Step 68-F. Cover only source-proven POST /admin/sales-control/preview and POST /admin/sales-control/apply authority across global/brand/category/product/variant scopes. Preserve the ten-minute single-use preview, exact server-returned affected_count, Step-Up-only apply, server-owned authorization, safe cancel-first review, no blind retry after ambiguous mutations, and explicit expired/unknown-outcome recovery. Do not invent fresh recount, requester binding, generic approval/replay/audit-history, generic bulk catalog editing, pricing/inventory/FX/Excel, Backend/OpenAPI/database changes, Storefront changes or Product Design semantic changes.

dependencies.evidence: PR #366 merged after exact-artifact Project Owner approval; exact-SHA Canonical CI #1969, Phase A #1468 and CodeQL #1119 succeeded; terminal Lock release comment 6232856088.

acceptance_criteria.description: Sales-Control uses only the canonical generated Admin preview/apply endpoints through the existing server-owned auth bridge; no parallel credential or browser auth authority is introduced.

Preview supports only global/brand/category/product/variant; non-global scope requires a bounded target EntityId, the desired sales_enabled value is explicit, and the UI does not invent generic bulk catalog fields.

The preview screen presents the server-returned preview_id, scope, sales_enabled, affected_count and expires_at as authoritative. The ten-minute preview is treated as single-use and the UI never claims a fresh recount or requester binding.
Apply is unavailable until an explicit review and WebAuthn Step-Up complete. The verified step-up token stays server-side for the apply request and is not persisted or rendered.
Apply sends the reviewed preview_id, a bounded operator reason and the exact reviewed affected_count as expected_affected_count. It never substitutes a locally recomputed count.
The safe cancel action receives initial dialog focus; Escape cancels and restores the launcher; apply is submitted once and disabled while in flight.
Expired/consumed preview and AFFECTED_COUNT_CHANGED outcomes never replay apply. The operator must obtain a fresh preview and review it again.
Network/timeout/abort, HTTP 408/5xx and post-submit ambiguity fail closed as unknown_outcome. The UI instructs manual canonical target review and never blindly repeats preview or apply.
All form mutations enforce trusted same-origin submission, bounded inputs and neutral 401/403/409/422/unknown handling with request-id evidence where available.
AD-C-08 is Persian RTL, responsive and keyboard-accessible with long-text wrapping, 44px controls, deterministic error/result focus and no horizontal overflow.

No Media, Product/Variant/Taxonomy mutation expansion, pricing/inventory/FX/Excel, Backend/OpenAPI/generated-contract/database, Storefront, Product Design semantic mutation or Current-State/Master-Roadmap closure reconciliation is introduced.

Canonical closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A and CodeQL, deterministic Review, Independent Security PASS, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock and explicit Project Owner Human Gate approval, followed by protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 68-G is HIGH risk. Project Owner Human Gate is mandatory only on the final exact HEAD and Artifact after CI, deterministic Review, Independent Security and exact-artifact Lock are complete. Step 68-H remains blocked until terminal canonical closure.
